statusText: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES. Tail crosses to 25% and enters the elevated band as the advance accepts above its named uptrend-resumption pivot.
recommendation: Tail has crossed the 25% block threshold. The preceding assessment named acceptance above 31,094.75 as the condition for an upward reassessment, and that condition has now been met alongside a fourth hour of extension and price held within 16.25 points of a fresh high. The advance remains a thin-liquidity Globex grind that has not met a liquid two-way session, and the long end of the Treasury curve still does not confirm it, which is why the reading sits at the bottom of the elevated band rather than higher. Concentrated event risk falls in the narrow 12:00-15:00Z window spanning US jobless claims, a Fed appearance, the cash open and ISM manufacturing.
headline: NQ accepts above the 31,094.75 pivot at 31,131.50 and holds a fresh 31,147.75 high, lifting Tail to 25% as a 5.63% 30-year yield withholds confirmation
body: December E-mini Nasdaq-100 futures trade 31,131.50, up 432.75 points or 1.41% from the 30,698.75 settle, after printing a fresh overnight high at 31,147.75 and holding within 16.25 points of it. The decisive change this hour is that price has accepted above the 31,094.75 pivot identified in the preceding assessment as the level marking genuine uptrend resumption, and now trades roughly 36.75 points clear of it. A second source corroborates the level at 31,135.00, up 436.25 points or 1.42%, with a 31,151.50 high and 68,343 contracts. The Globex path remains close to one-way: the session low is 30,684.50, the range spans 463.25 points or 1.51%, and there has still been no observed retracement test of the reclaimed 30,812.75 shelf across four consecutive hours of extension. Turnover has risen to 68.64k from 53.53k an hour earlier, which is a liquidity improvement but remains thin for a pre-event Globex session. The driver is unchanged and identifiable: Micron's fiscal fourth quarter delivered adjusted earnings of 33.42 dollars per share against 31.16 expected on 54.23 billion dollars of revenue, with first-quarter revenue guided to 61.5 billion dollars and earnings to 38.15 dollars plus or minus one dollar against a 36.02 consensus, and fourth-quarter DRAM revenue of 39.8 billion dollars up 343% year over year. That lifted Japan's Nikkei 225 by 2.8% to 68,606.81 with Lasertec up about 10%, Taiyo Yuden 8.3%, Advantest nearly 8%, Murata 7.4%, Tokyo Electron 6%, TDK 5.5%, Kioxia 4.6% and Rohm 4%, while the Kospi added 1.2%. Against that, the completed cash session argues reversion is intact: NDX closed 30,408.50, up 0.23%, at the exact low of a 30,408.50 to 30,630.45 range and therefore a full intraday fade. Cross-assets continue to withhold confirmation. The 2-year sits at 4.90%, the 5-year 5.09%, the 10-year 5.29% and the 30-year 5.63%, all marginally lower on the day but with the 10-year and 30-year still at their highest since 2002 on energy-related inflation and fiscal concern, and that refusal of the long end to retreat is the same mechanism that faded an earlier risk-asset pop. WTI is 89.52 dollars, down 0.99%, Brent 97.404 dollars, down 0.64%, and the VIX closed 16.34, up 1.87% from 16.04 but still low. August core PCE at 0.2% monthly and 3.0% annually against 3.3% expected, with headline at 3.4% against 3.7%, has cut October Fed hike odds to roughly 35% from about 50% the prior day. Three amplifiers are now observed together: repeated extension to fresh overnight highs, price held at the session extreme, and acceptance above the named uptrend-resumption pivot, alongside aligned Asian semiconductor participation. They remain offset by thin pre-event liquidity, an unconfirmed long end, softer oil, a subdued VIX and a cash session that mean-reverted in full. On the balance that the named upgrade condition has actually been met, Tail firms one point to 25% and crosses into the elevated band, mapping the policy state to BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES. Shared Finviz context was collected 2026-09-29T23:14:22Z with partial status, so at roughly 31 hours old it is stale under the 90-minute freshness rule and was not used; this assessment rests entirely on independent current research.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding hourly slots carry published Claude assessments. Tail sat at 15-16% through the European and early US hours of 30 September with the mode mixed, stepped into the watch band at 20% from 12:00Z as the US data block and the long-end selloff developed, and peaked at 23% around 15:00-16:00Z. It held a 20-22% range through the US afternoon and the early Asian session, then firmed steadily from 20% at 00:00Z to 21%, 22%, 23% and 24% as NQ printed successive fresh overnight highs, with the mode turning trend-up in the final slot. Stress stayed in the high band throughout, between 65% and 72%, and Confidence held 87-88%.
outlookSummary: The mapped danger window is 12:00-15:00Z, covering initial and continuing jobless claims at 12:30Z, Fed's Barkin at 13:05Z, the 13:30Z cash open, the final S&P Global manufacturing PMI at 13:45Z and ISM manufacturing plus August construction spending at 14:00Z. Forecast Tail opens at 25% in the elevated band and holds there through the late Asian and early European hours while the overnight bid remains untested, eases to 24% across the European morning where two-way liquidity would normally produce a measurable retracement, then returns to 25% and peaks at 26% across the 13:00-14:00Z cash-open and ISM hours where Stress tops at 77%. It decays to 21-22% through the US afternoon, the cash close and the late evening, then firms marginally to 22-23% through the Asian session as positioning concentrates ahead of the September employment report at 12:30Z on 2 October, which falls outside this forecast window. Treating the event stack as a checkpoint rather than an automatic block follows the observed pattern that release importance and surprise magnitude primarily raise Stress and whipsaw risk. A further upward reassessment would require the overnight structure to survive a liquid session: shallow or failed retracements after the cash open, repeated extension following a failed pullback, NQ holding a session extreme through the US afternoon, or the long end of the curve finally realigning behind the move. A measurable retracement into the 30,812.75 shelf, or rejection back beneath 31,094.75, would argue for a step back into the watch band.

forecastDetail.comment: NQ at 31,131.50 and plus 1.41% has accepted roughly 36.75 points above the 31,094.75 uptrend-resumption pivot named in the prior hour, printing a fresh 31,147.75 high and holding 16.25 points beneath it; a fourth consecutive hour of extension with no retracement test across a 463.25-point range lifts Tail one point to 25% and maps the policy state to BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES, while 68.64k turnover and a 5.63% 30-year yield still withhold confirmation.

The European cash open is the first hour in which genuine two-way liquidity can test an advance that has not yet been tested; Tail holds 25% on the assumption the bid stays intact, and a measurable retracement into the reclaimed 30,812.75 shelf would be the clearest argument for easing.

Acceptance or rejection of the 31,094.75 pivot is this hour's structural test: continued holding near the session extreme would keep both observed amplifiers active, while a rejection back beneath that level would mark the first break of the overnight trend, with a 16.34 VIX still arguing against disorderly repricing.

Challenger job cuts at 09:30Z is a medium-impact labour checkpoint ahead of the US block, and Tail eases to 24% on the expectation that a full European session normally produces at least one measurable retracement; continued extension without a pullback would invalidate that easing.

A mid-morning European hour with no scheduled US catalyst, where consolidation of the overnight gain rather than fresh extension is the conditional base case; Stress stays at 72% because a 30-year yield near its highest since 2002, with WTI at 89.52 and Brent at 97.40, keeps the drawdown environment difficult even when the path mean-reverts.

Positioning into the 12:30Z claims print thins liquidity and firms Stress to 73%; any directional push in this hour reflects pre-release positioning rather than confirmed structure, so it should not by itself be read as established one-way behaviour.
